purpose: Prevent source summaries and external frequencies from silently becoming local simulation parameters

checks: Preserve reported and calculated percentages separately
Only calculate n/N when n is a subset of that exact N
Do not add overlapping diagnoses as exclusive branches
Diagnostic yield after selected referral is not prevalence among all ED arrivals
Observed treatment-arm differences do not establish the effect for a new hospital
Separate licensed, physical, staffed, open and free capacity
Availability may vary with shift, breaks, acuity and competing duties
A published simulation roster is an assumption unless its observed basis is documented
Do not compute joint availability by multiplying marginal availability without dependence evidence
Patient departure to room ready can include queues and cleaning
Cleaning service time is not the same as bed assignment or next-patient arrival
Before/after cohorts require workflow and case-mix context
Do not sum overlapping intervals or treat mean confidence limits as patient quantiles
Record both conflicting statements and exact locators
No author intent inferred from whichever value fits expectations
Resolved notation does not establish fit quality or transportability
Keep original evidence and add a linked correction or interpretation

activation: Requires separate human extraction review, clinical or operational applicability review, and explicit scenario adoption; this contract grants none
